paite: Diktatna delh mite, "Nou, TOUPA zong mite aw, ka thu ngaikhia un: noute sekna suangpi lam leh noute tohkhiakna kokhuk lam en un.
heading: Jerusalem Lungmuanna Thute
english: “Listen to me, you who follow after righteousness, you who seek Yahweh. Look to the rock you were cut from, and to the quarry you were dug from.

paite: Na pu uh Abraham lam leh noute hon suangnu Sarah lam en un; khat kia ahih lai in ka sam a, ka vualzawl a, mi tampi ding in ka bawlta hi.
english: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who bore you; for when he was but one I called him, I blessed him, and made him many.

paite: "Na TOUPA'N Zion alungmuanta ngal a; amun sesate tengteng alungmuan a, Eden bang in agamdai abawl a, agamkeu leng TOUPA huan bang in abawl hi; huai ah kipahna leh nopsaknate, kipahthu genna leh lasak husate a-om ding hi.
english: For Yahweh has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Yahweh. Joy and gladness will be found in them, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

paite: "Ka mite aw, ka thu ngaikhia unla; ka namte aw, ka thu bil na doh un; kei a pan in dan thu ahong pawt ding a, michih vakna ding in ka vaihawmna ka kipsak ding.
english: “Listen to me, my people; and hear me, my nation, for a law will go out from me, and I will establish my justice for a light to the peoples.

paite: Ka diktatna anai a, ka hotdamna apawtta, ka bante'n michih vai ahawmsak ding, tuikulh gamte'n ahon ngak ding ua, ka ban amuang ding uh.
english: My righteousness is near. My salvation has gone out, and my arms will judge the peoples. The islands will wait for me, and they will trust my arm.

paite: Van lam ah daktou unla, nuailam ah lei en un; van meikhu bang in azammang ding a, puansilh bang in leitung alui ding, asung a omte huchibang in asi ding uh; ka hotdamna bel tangtawn in a-om ding, ka diktatna leng hihman in a-om kei ding.
english: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will vanish away like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Its inhabitants will die in the same way, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.

paite: "Diktatna theimi, ka dan thu lungtang a pai mite aw, ka thu ngaikhia un; mihing gensiatna lau kei unla, ahon tainate uh ziak in lunghimoh kei un.
english: “Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Don’t fear the reproach of men, and don’t be dismayed at their insults.

paite: Sim in puansilh anekgawp vek bang in, amaute anegawp vek ding, nget in samul anek bang in, amaute ane ding; ka diktatna tangtawn in a-om ding a, ka hotdamna suan tengteng tan in a-om ding.
english: For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation to all generations.”

paite: "AW TOUPA ban aw, halh inla, hatna kisilh in; nidanglai a, tang a suante om lai a na halh bang in halh in. Nang Rahab satzanpa, dragon sunpa na hi kei a hia?
english: Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it you who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the monster?

paite: Nang tuipi, tui thuk zapi tui kangsakpa, tatsate paisuakna lampi ding a tuipi taw bawlsakpa na hi kei a hia?
english: Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?

paite: TOUPA tatsate akik nawn ding ua, la sa kawm in Zion atung ding ua; tangtawn a kipahna alutung uah a-omta ding; kipahna leh nopsakna amu ding ua, lungkhamna leh mauna amangta ding.
english: Those ransomed by Yahweh will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy. Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

paite: "Kei, kei mahmah, nou lungmuanpa ka hi; si ding mihing kihta ding, loupa bang a bawl ding mihing tapa kihta ding nang kua hi na hia;
english: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?

paite: Na TOUPA nang hon Bawlpa, van kaipalh a lei kingaknate phumpa, mangngilh a, nuaisiahmi hihse ding a angim lai hehna ziak lel a nitum a lau? Nuaisiah mi hehna koi a om ahita a?
english: Have you forgotten Yahweh your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live in fear continually all day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he prepares to destroy? Where is the fury of the oppressor?

paite: Sal pimang kintak a khah in a-om ding a, suangkul ah asi kei dia, an nek ding atasam kei ding hi.
english: The captive exile will speedily be freed. He will not die and go down into the pit. His bread won’t fail.

paite: "Kei na TOUPA na Pathian, tuipi kihot ging honhonte khen a tuipi tokletpa ka hi ngal a; ka min sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: For I am Yahweh your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

paite: Van ka kaihpalh a, lei kingaknate ka phum theih a, Zionte kiang a, ka mite na hi uh, ka chih theihna ding in ka thute na kam ah ka koih a, ka khut in ka hon hum hi.
english: I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and tell Zion, ‘You are my people.’”

paite: Jerusalem aw, Na TOUPA khut a kipan ahehna nou dawnnu, halh inla, thou in; nang hoihoina nou a anengte na dawn a, na dawn siang sipsip hi.
heading: Jerusalem Thuakna Tawpna
english: Awake, awake! Stand up, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from Yahweh’s hand the cup of his wrath. You have drunken the bowl of the cup of staggering, and drained it.

paite: Atapa suan tengteng lak a pi ding kuamah a-om kei ua; atapa vaklet teng lak ah akhut a len kuamah a-om kei uh.
english: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth; and there is no one who takes her by the hand among all the sons whom she has brought up.

paite: "Hiai thil nihte'n ahon phat ahi; kua'n ahon kahpih ding ua? Gamna leh siatna leh kial, leh namsau; bangchi in ka hon lungmuan diam aw?
english: These two things have happened to you— who will grieve with you?— desolation and destruction, and famine and the sword. How can I comfort you?

paite: Na tapate abah ua, sathak len a awk bang in, kongzing lu lam ah alum uhi; TOUPA hehna leh na Pathian salhna in adim uhi.
english: Your sons have fainted. They lie at the head of all the streets, like an antelope in a net. They are full of Yahweh’s wrath, the rebuke of your God.

paite: "Huaiziak in nang hihgentheih leh uain kham hilou a mi kham, hiai za in.
english: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

paite: Na TOUPA Jehovah, na Pathian, amite thu genpihpa'n, hichi in achi, 'Ngai in, hoihoina nou, ka hehna nou belhbu ngei, na khut a kipan ka lakheta; na dawn nawnta kei ding,'
english: Your Lord Yahweh, your God who pleads the cause of his people, says, “Behold, I have taken out of your hand the cup of staggering, even the bowl of the cup of my wrath. You will not drink it any more.

paite: Huchi in nang hon hihgentheite khut ah ka koih ding; mamau na hinna kiang ah, 'K'on tot ding un bokkhup un,' achi uh; huchi in atawn mite kiang ah na nungzang lei leh kongzing bang in na doh," chi in.
english: I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over you;’ and you have laid your back as the ground, like a street to those who walk over.”
